product: Keychron QMK keyboards: Keychron's own settings on top of VIA
works: written from docs/brands/keychron.md (Keychron's QMK fork) and checked against a simulated keyboard only (tests/sim-keychron-via.mjs)
a driver.json: DeviceHub's safety check (helpers/declarative-driver.mjs validate) passes it
reads: Keychron protocol version and feature bits, debounce method and time, wireless backlight-off and sleep timers, report rate, NKRO state

writes (one at a time, read back, the old value put back on a mismatch; refused while a Keychron or VIA desktop app runs): debounce method, debounce time 0-100 ms, backlight-off 5-3600 s, sleep 60-14400 s, report rate 1000 / 4000 / 8000 Hz
each setting is offered only when the board's own A7 01 feature bits say it has it; a board without Keychron's commands shows none
doesNotWork: keys, layers, macros and lighting here (DeviceHub's VIA keyboard page already has them)
snap click (SOCD), NKRO switching, Keychron per-key lighting (A8), HE actuation and rapid trigger (A9)
battery (no raw HID command exists), the 2.4 GHz receiver and Bluetooth
